verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer portal documents a test account for trying custom integrations and apps without affecting the production account. It also says you can load that test account with sample data to explore the API. That covers the core story, but the evidence is two short marketing-level lines from the developer homepage. missing for 10: in-depth docs on provisioning and isolation guarantees of test accounts, limits or parity with production, guidance on pointing API keys, SDKs or the MCP server at the test account, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Test custom integrations and apps without the risk of impacting your production account.
Populate your test account with sample data to quickly explore our API and see how data is used in Klaviyo.
